about-licenses.name: License texts
about-licenses.text: The full text of every license Plynth ships. Click one to read it here.

about-notices.name: Third party notices
about-notices.text: Every library, font and data file Plynth ships that was not written for it, with its license and copyright.

about-page.name: About Plynth
about-page.text: The version, the licenses of Plynth and its samples, and the notices of everything it ships.

about-version.name: Version
about-version.text: The version of this copy of Plynth.

banner-read-only.name: Read only banner
banner-read-only.text: The command line is editing this project, so the app only shows it. The plan updates as the commands run.

banner-unlock.name: Unlock
banner-unlock.text: Ends the command line session and makes the project editable here again.

build-bar.name: Build bar
build-bar.text: Switches between the plan and the 3D view and starts a build. It also shows how the last build went.

build-button.name: Build
build-button.text: Builds the building in Blender in the background. The plan stays editable while it runs.

build-cancel.name: Cancel build
build-cancel.text: Stops the running build. The last finished building stays as it was.

build-cancel-action.name: Cancel build
build-cancel-action.text: Stops the running build. The last finished building stays as it was.

build-open-blender.name: Open in Blender
build-open-blender.text: Opens the built building.blend in Blender, so you can look at it or change it by hand.

build-open-blender-action.name: Open in Blender
build-open-blender-action.text: Opens the built building.blend in Blender, so you can look at it or change it by hand.

build-open-folder.name: Open build folder
build-open-folder.text: Opens the folder with the built files in Explorer.

build-open-folder-action.name: Open build folder
build-open-folder-action.text: Opens the folder with the built files in Explorer.

build-panel.name: Build tab
build-panel.text: The last build: what was made, the files, each step and any problems found.

build-problems.name: Build problems
build-problems.text: How many problems the last build found. Click it to list them.

build-progress.name: Build progress
build-progress.text: How far the running build has come.

build-report.name: Show build report
build-report.text: Shows the last build in the Build tab.

build-run.name: Build
build-run.text: Builds the building in Blender in the background. The plan stays editable while it runs.

build-status.name: Build status
build-status.text: What the last build did, or what the running build is doing now.

canvas-plan.name: Plan sheet
canvas-plan.text: Your floor plan with the walls, rooms, openings and furniture on it. The wheel zooms and a middle drag pans.

catalog-add-material.name: Add to materials
catalog-add-material.text: Copies this material of the asset into the materials catalog as a material of its own.

catalog-assets.name: Assets catalog
catalog-assets.text: The models in your library. Search them, pick one and edit its details.

catalog-categories.name: Categories
catalog-categories.text: Tick every category the asset belongs to. The furniture picker lists assets by category.

catalog-category.name: Category filter
catalog-category.text: Shows only the assets of one category, or the ones without a category.

catalog-grid.name: Assets
catalog-grid.text: The assets in the library. Click one to see and edit its details.

catalog-id.name: Asset id
catalog-id.text: The id of the asset. The plan and the command line use it.

catalog-import.name: Import assets
catalog-import.text: Imports model files into the library. Blender cleans each one and renders a thumbnail.

catalog-import-action.name: Import asset
catalog-import-action.text: Imports model files into the library. Blender cleans each one and renders a thumbnail.

catalog-license.name: License
catalog-license.text: The license the asset came with. The license report of an export lists it.

catalog-materials.name: Asset materials
catalog-materials.text: The materials inside the asset. Each can be added to the materials catalog.

catalog-name.name: Asset name
catalog-name.text: The name shown in the catalog. Press Enter to save a new one.

catalog-open-folder.name: Open asset folder
catalog-open-folder.text: Opens the folder of the asset in Explorer.

catalog-open-folder-action.name: Open library folder
catalog-open-folder-action.text: Opens the library folder in Explorer.

catalog-open-setup.name: Open setup check
catalog-open-setup.text: Opens the setup check, where you choose or create the library folder.

catalog-queue.name: Import queue
catalog-queue.text: The imports that are running or waiting, with a way to cancel each one.

catalog-remove.name: Remove asset
catalog-remove.text: Deletes the asset and its folder from the library. This cannot be undone.

catalog-rescan.name: Rescan
catalog-rescan.text: Reads the library folder again and updates the index.

catalog-rescan-action.name: Rescan library
catalog-rescan-action.text: Reads the library folder again and updates the index.

catalog-retry.name: Retry render
catalog-retry.text: Measures the asset again in Blender and renders a new thumbnail.

catalog-room.name: Room filter
catalog-room.text: Shows only the assets that belong in one kind of room.

catalog-room-types.name: Room types and categories
catalog-room-types.text: Edits the kinds of room, the asset categories and which categories belong in which room.

catalog-sample-shapes.name: Add the sample shapes
catalog-sample-shapes.text: Copies the sample opening shapes, such as the keyhole, into the library.

catalog-search.name: Search assets
catalog-search.text: Type part of a name, tag or category. The grid filters as you type.

catalog-show.name: Assets catalog
catalog-show.text: Shows the Assets tab with the models in your library.

catalog-size.name: Size
catalog-size.text: The width, depth and height of the asset in metres, as Blender measured it.

catalog-source.name: Source
catalog-source.text: Where the asset came from and when it was imported.

catalog-tags.name: Tags
catalog-tags.text: Words that help you find the asset. Press Enter to save them.

catalog-thumbnail.name: Asset preview
catalog-thumbnail.text: The asset in 3D. Drag to turn it and use the wheel to zoom.

catalog-triangles.name: Triangles
catalog-triangles.text: How many triangles the model has.

catalog-warnings.name: Asset warnings
catalog-warnings.text: What the import and the last render found that you may want to fix.

categories-remove.name: Remove category
categories-remove.text: Removes the selected category from every asset and room type.

categories-rename.name: Rename category
categories-rename.text: Changes the name of the selected category.

detect-accept.name: Accept
detect-accept.text: Adds the walls, openings and rooms detection found to the plan. You can undo it.

dialog-scale.name: Set scale
dialog-scale.text: Tells Plynth how long the line you drew is in real life, so the whole plan gets its size in metres.

edit-delete.name: Delete
edit-delete.text: Deletes the selected item and what depends on it.

edit-redo.name: Redo
edit-redo.text: Brings back the change you undid.

edit-undo.name: Undo
edit-undo.text: Takes back the last change to the plan.

export-anyway.name: Export anyway
export-anyway.text: Exports although some quality checks failed. Plynth asks before it does.

export-anyway-action.name: Export anyway
export-anyway-action.text: Exports although some quality checks of the last export failed. Plynth asks before it does.

export-build.name: Build first
export-build.text: Builds the building, since there is nothing to export yet.

export-check.name: Check
export-check.text: Runs the quality checks of the export and writes no files.

export-check-action.name: Check export
export-check-action.text: Runs the quality checks of the export and writes no files.

export-check-row.name: Quality check
export-check-row.text: One quality check and its result. Click it to see what it found.

export-open-folder.name: Open export folder
export-open-folder.text: Opens the folder with the exported files in Explorer.

export-open-folder-action.name: Open export folder
export-open-folder-action.text: Opens the folder with the exported files in Explorer.

export-panel.name: Export tab
export-panel.text: The export for Unreal: the last export, its files and the quality checks.

export-run.name: Export
export-run.text: Writes the FBX file and its textures for Unreal after the quality checks pass.

export-run-action.name: Export
export-run-action.text: Writes the FBX file and its textures for Unreal after the quality checks pass.

file-close.name: Close project
file-close.text: Closes the project and goes to the home screen.

file-home.name: Home
file-home.text: Shows the home screen with your recent projects.

file-new-from-image.name: New project from image
file-new-from-image.text: Starts a new project from a picture of a floor plan.

file-save-as.name: Save as
file-save-as.text: Saves the project in another folder.

file-set-image.name: Set plan image
file-set-image.text: Picks the plan image of the floor you are working on.

floor-add.name: Add floor
floor-add.text: Adds a floor above the top floor.

floor-tab.name: Floor
floor-tab.text: One floor of the building. Click it to work on that floor.

floor-tabs.name: Floors
floor-tabs.text: The floors of the building, lowest first. Click one to work on it.

furniture-picker.name: Furniture picker
furniture-picker.text: Picks what to place: a room type, then a category, then an asset. Generators are listed too.

generator-group.name: Generator parameters
generator-group.text: The settings of the generator this item runs, such as its height or the number of parts.

generator-param-*.name: Generator parameter
generator-param-*.text: One setting of the generator. The next build uses the new value.

generator-reset.name: Reset to defaults
generator-reset.text: Gives every parameter of this item its default value.

generator-update.name: Update parameters
generator-update.text: Fits the stored values to the generator as it is now.

generators-check-addons-action.name: Check add-ons
generators-check-addons-action.text: Asks Blender which add-ons are enabled, so the generators that need one show as available.

generators-open-folder-action.name: Open generators folder
generators-open-folder-action.text: Opens the folder of generator files in Explorer.

generators-samples-action.name: Add the sample generators
generators-samples-action.text: Copies the sample generators that come with Plynth into the library.

help-about.name: About Plynth
help-about.text: Shows the version, the licenses and the notices of everything Plynth ships.

help-back.name: Back
help-back.text: Goes back to the page you saw before.

help-contents.name: Help
help-contents.text: Opens the help pages, the same files as the docs folder.

help-page.name: Help page
help-page.text: The page you picked. Links to other pages open here, and web links open in your browser.

help-pages.name: Help pages
help-pages.text: The help pages. Click one to read it.

help-results.name: Search results
help-results.text: Every place the words you typed appear, headings first. Click one to open the page there.

help-search.name: Search help
help-search.text: Type words to find them in every help page.

help-setup-check.name: Setup check
help-setup-check.text: Checks that Blender, the library folder and the projects folder are ready.

help-tour-*.name: Guided tour
help-tour-*.text: Shows the controls of one screen one at a time, with what each does.

help-what-is-this.name: What is this?
help-what-is-this.text: Turn it on and click any control to see what it does. The control is not run.

help-window.name: Help
help-window.text: The help pages of Plynth with a search across all of them.

home-back.name: Back to project
home-back.text: Goes back to the project that is open.

home-new-from-image.name: New project from plan image
home-new-from-image.text: Starts a new project from a picture of a floor plan. Plynth can find the walls in it for you.

home-projects-folder.name: Projects folder
home-projects-folder.text: Opens the folder where new projects go.

home-recent-empty.name: No recent projects
home-recent-empty.text: Projects you open or save show up here.

home-recent-list.name: Recent projects
home-recent-list.text: Projects you opened or saved lately. Click one to open it.

home-recent-remove.name: Remove from list
home-recent-remove.text: Takes this project off the list. Nothing on disk is deleted.

home-recent-row.name: Recent project
home-recent-row.text: A project you opened lately. Click it to open it again.

home-recent-show.name: Show folder
home-recent-show.text: Opens the project folder in Explorer.

home-sample-*.name: Sample plan
home-sample-*.text: Starts a new project from this sample plan image, drawn for Plynth.

home-screen.name: Home
home-screen.text: Your recent projects, new projects and the help pages.

home-search.name: Search projects
home-search.text: Type part of a project name or folder to filter the list.

home-setup-fix.name: Fix setup
home-setup-fix.text: Opens the setup check, where you can fix what is missing.

home-setup-path.name: Setup details
home-setup-path.text: The Blender and library folder Plynth uses.

home-setup-status.name: Setup status
home-setup-status.text: Whether Blender, the library folder and the add-ons are ready.

item-bottom-height.name: Bottom height
item-bottom-height.text: How high the bottom of the item sits above the floor.

item-centre-height.name: Centre height
item-centre-height.text: How high the middle of the item sits above the floor.

item-mount.name: Mount on wall
item-mount.text: Hangs the item flat on the nearest wall, such as a TV or a mirror.

item-properties.name: Furniture item
item-properties.text: The settings of the selected piece of furniture.

item-rotation.name: Rotation
item-rotation.text: How far the item is turned on the plan, in degrees clockwise.

item-swap.name: Swap asset
item-swap.text: Picks another asset for this item. It keeps its place.

item-take-off.name: Take off wall
item-take-off.text: Takes the item off its wall. It stays where it is.

item-thumbnail.name: Item thumbnail
item-thumbnail.text: The thumbnail of the asset this item shows.

item-turn-left.name: Turn left
item-turn-left.text: Turns the item a quarter turn counterclockwise.

item-turn-right.name: Turn right
item-turn-right.text: Turns the item a quarter turn clockwise.

item-update-size.name: Update size
item-update-size.text: Uses the size the library has now for this asset.

item-x.name: Position X
item-x.text: Where the centre of the item is on the plan, from left to right.

item-y.name: Position Y
item-y.text: Where the centre of the item is on the plan, from top to bottom.

material-picker.name: Material picker
material-picker.text: Picks a material: first a group, then a material.

material-picker-groups.name: Material groups
material-picker-groups.text: Pick a group to see its materials.

material-picker-materials.name: Materials
material-picker-materials.text: Click a material to use it. Hover over one to see it.

material-picker-preview.name: Material preview
material-picker-preview.text: The material under the cursor with its tile size, groups and license.

material-picker-roof.name: Roof covering
material-picker-roof.text: The material of this roof section. Without one, the project default for this kind of roof is used.

material-picker-room-ceiling.name: Ceiling material
material-picker-room-ceiling.text: The material of the ceiling of this room. Without one, the project default is used.

material-picker-room-floor.name: Floor material
material-picker-room-floor.text: The material of the floor of this room. Without one, the project default is used.

material-picker-room-wall.name: Wall material
material-picker-room-wall.text: The material of the wall faces that look into this room, unless a wall has its own.

material-picker-stair.name: Stair material
material-picker-stair.text: The material of the steps and landings of this stair.

material-picker-wall-inside.name: Inside material
material-picker-wall-inside.text: The material of the face of this wall that looks into a room.

material-picker-wall-outside.name: Outside material
material-picker-wall-outside.text: The material of the face of this wall that looks outdoors.

materials-add-samples.name: Add the sample materials
materials-add-samples.text: Imports the sample materials that come with Plynth. New projects use them by default.

materials-grid.name: Materials
materials-grid.text: The materials in the library. Click one to see and edit its details.

materials-group.name: Group filter
materials-group.text: Shows only the materials of one group, or the ones without a group.

materials-group-remove.name: Remove group
materials-group-remove.text: Deletes the group shown in the filter. The materials stay but lose the group.

materials-group-rename.name: Rename group
materials-group-rename.text: Changes the name of the group shown in the filter.

materials-groups.name: Groups
materials-groups.text: Tick every group the material belongs to. The material picker lists materials by group.

materials-id.name: Material id
materials-id.text: The id of the material. The plan and the command line use it.

materials-import.name: Import materials
materials-import.text: Opens the screen that imports texture folders, images and Blender materials.

materials-import-action.name: Import materials
materials-import-action.text: Opens the screen that imports texture folders, images and Blender materials.

materials-import-add-files.name: Add files
materials-import-add-files.text: Picks zip files, image files or a .blend file to import.

materials-import-add-folder.name: Add folder
materials-import-add-folder.text: Picks a folder that holds the texture images of one material.

materials-import-back.name: Back
materials-import-back.text: Closes the import screen and goes back to the plan.

materials-import-bake.name: Bake size
materials-import-bake.text: The size of the images made from a Blender material that is not plain image textures.

materials-import-blend-material.name: Blender material
materials-import-blend-material.text: Which material of a .blend file to take, when the file holds several.

materials-import-channel-*.name: Texture map
materials-import-channel-*.text: The image file used for this map of the material.

materials-import-channel-browse.name: Browse
materials-import-channel-browse.text: Picks the image file for this map.

materials-import-form.name: Import settings
materials-import-form.text: The name, groups, tags, license and tile size the imported material gets.

materials-import-groups.name: Groups
materials-import-groups.text: The groups the material goes in. With none ticked, Plynth asks after the import.

materials-import-license.name: License
materials-import-license.text: The license the material came with. The first entry takes it from the source.

materials-import-name.name: Name
materials-import-name.text: The name shown in the catalog. Leave it empty to take the name from the source.

materials-import-normal.name: Normal map style
materials-import-normal.text: Pick DirectX when bumps look inverted. A map with dx in its name is found by itself.

materials-import-note.name: Left out
materials-import-note.text: Why something was left out of the list.

materials-import-remove.name: Remove
materials-import-remove.text: Takes the selected lines off the list.

materials-import-screen.name: Import materials
materials-import-screen.text: Imports texture folders, zip files, images and Blender materials into the materials catalog.

materials-import-set-tile.name: Set tile size
materials-import-set-tile.text: How far one repeat of the texture reaches on a wall or floor. When off, the size comes from the source.

materials-import-sources.name: Sources
materials-import-sources.text: What will be imported. Drop folders, zip files, images or a .blend file here, or use the buttons.

materials-import-start.name: Import
materials-import-start.text: Adds every line of the list to the import queue.

materials-import-tags.name: Tags
materials-import-tags.text: Words that help you find the material.

materials-import-tile-height.name: Tile height
materials-import-tile-height.text: The height of one tile of the texture in metres.

materials-import-tile-width.name: Tile width
materials-import-tile-width.text: The width of one tile of the texture in metres.

materials-license.name: License
materials-license.text: The license the material came with. The license report of an export lists it.

materials-maps.name: Maps
materials-maps.text: The images the material is made of, and how each was made.

materials-name.name: Material name
materials-name.text: The name shown in the catalog. Press Enter to save a new one.

materials-open-folder.name: Open material folder
materials-open-folder.text: Opens the folder of the material in Explorer.

materials-open-setup.name: Open setup check
materials-open-setup.text: Opens the setup check, where you choose or create the library folder.

materials-panel.name: Materials catalog
materials-panel.text: The surface materials in your library. Search them, pick one and edit its details.

materials-remove.name: Remove material
materials-remove.text: Deletes the material and its folder from the library. This cannot be undone.

materials-rescan.name: Rescan
materials-rescan.text: Reads the materials folder again and updates the index.

materials-rescan-action.name: Rescan materials
materials-rescan-action.text: Reads the materials folder again and updates the index.

materials-retry.name: Retry render
materials-retry.text: Cleans the maps again and renders a new thumbnail.

materials-samples-action.name: Add the sample materials
materials-samples-action.text: Imports the sample materials that come with Plynth.

materials-search.name: Search materials
materials-search.text: Type part of a name, tag or group. The grid filters as you type.

materials-show.name: Materials catalog
materials-show.text: Shows the Materials tab with the surface materials in your library.

materials-tags.name: Tags
materials-tags.text: Words that help you find the material. Press Enter to save them.

materials-texture-size.name: Texture size
materials-texture-size.text: The size in pixels of the base color image.

materials-thumbnail.name: Material thumbnail
materials-thumbnail.text: A sphere and a flat tile at real size, rendered by Blender.

materials-tile-height.name: Tile height
materials-tile-height.text: The real height of one tile of the texture. Press Enter to save it.

materials-tile-width.name: Tile width
materials-tile-width.text: The real width of one tile of the texture, along the wall or floor. Press Enter to save it.

materials-warnings.name: Material warnings
materials-warnings.text: What the import and the last render found that you may want to fix.

menu.name: Menu
menu.text: Every action of Plynth with its keyboard shortcut.

panel-ceiling-height.name: Ceiling height
panel-ceiling-height.text: The height of the ceiling of this floor. Walls without their own height use it.

panel-corner-radius.name: Corner radius
panel-corner-radius.text: Rounds the corner with an arc of this radius where two straight walls meet.

panel-delete.name: Delete
panel-delete.text: Deletes the selected item and what depends on it.

panel-detect.name: Detection settings
panel-detect.text: Settings for finding the walls in the plan image.

panel-detect-detector.name: Detector
panel-detect-detector.text: The way walls are found in the image.

panel-detect-length.name: Shortest wall
panel-detect-length.text: Wall pieces shorter than this are left out.

panel-detect-opening.name: Widest opening
panel-detect-opening.text: A gap up to this wide is closed with wall and marked as an opening.

panel-detect-openings.name: Find openings
panel-detect-openings.text: Finds doors, windows and gaps in the walls and adds them when you accept.

panel-detect-reset.name: Reset settings
panel-detect-reset.text: Puts every detection setting back to its default.

panel-detect-rooms.name: Propose rooms
panel-detect-rooms.text: Also proposes a room for every closed area.

panel-detect-sensitivity.name: Sensitivity
panel-detect-sensitivity.text: Higher counts lighter grey as ink. Lower it for a plan on grey paper.

panel-detect-status.name: Detection result
panel-detect-status.text: What detection found, or why it could not run.

panel-detect-thickest.name: Thickest wall
panel-detect-thickest.text: Dark areas thicker than this are not walls, such as filled blocks.

panel-detect-thinnest.name: Thinnest wall
panel-detect-thinnest.text: Dark lines thinner than this are not walls. Raise it to leave out thin lines.

panel-floor-image.name: Choose image
panel-floor-image.text: Picks another plan image for this floor.

panel-floor-name.name: Floor name
panel-floor-name.text: The name of this floor, shown on its tab.

panel-grid-size.name: Grid size
panel-grid-size.text: The distance between grid lines. Points snap to the grid when snapping is on.

panel-image-offset-x.name: Image offset X
panel-image-offset-x.text: Moves the plan image of this floor left or right, to line it up with the floor below.

panel-image-offset-y.name: Image offset Y
panel-image-offset-y.text: Moves the plan image of this floor up or down, to line it up with the floor below.

panel-move-marks.name: Move marks with the image
panel-move-marks.text: When on, everything drawn on this floor moves with the image. When off, only the image moves.

panel-new-wall-thickness.name: New wall thickness
panel-new-wall-thickness.text: The thickness of the walls the Wall tool draws.

panel-opening-hinge.name: Hinge
panel-opening-hinge.text: The side of the door the hinges are on.

panel-opening-offset.name: Offset
panel-opening-offset.text: The distance along the wall from its first point to the middle of the opening.

panel-opening-shape.name: Shape
panel-opening-shape.text: The shape of the cutout in the wall.

panel-opening-sill.name: Sill
panel-opening-sill.text: The height of the bottom of the opening above the floor.

panel-opening-tool.name: Opening tool
panel-opening-tool.text: What the Opening tool places next and its size.

panel-opening-type.name: Opening type
panel-opening-type.text: Whether this opening is a door, a window or a plain gap.

panel-opening-width.name: Opening width
panel-opening-width.text: The width of the opening along the wall.

panel-point-x.name: Point X
panel-point-x.text: The position of the point from the left edge of the image.

panel-point-y.name: Point Y
panel-point-y.text: The position of the point from the top edge of the image.

panel-properties.name: Properties
panel-properties.text: The settings of what you selected, or of the plan when nothing is selected.

panel-right.name: Side panel
panel-right.text: Properties, the catalogs and the build and export tabs.

panel-roof-*.name: Roof section setting
panel-roof-*.text: A setting of this roof section. It overrides the roof default.

panel-roof-default-*.name: Roof default
panel-roof-default-*.text: A setting used by every roof section that has no settings of its own.

panel-roof-unused-remove.name: Remove unused roof entry
panel-roof-unused-remove.text: Removes this roof entry that no section uses. Undo brings it back.

panel-roof-use-default.name: Use the default
panel-roof-use-default.text: Removes the settings of this section so it follows the roof default again.

panel-room-type.name: Room type
panel-room-type.text: What kind of room this is. It decides which furniture the picker offers.

panel-slab-thickness.name: Slab thickness
panel-slab-thickness.text: The thickness of the slab between this floor and the next one up, or under the roof.

panel-stair-turn.name: Turn
panel-stair-turn.text: Which way the stair turns on its way up.

panel-stair-type.name: Stair type
panel-stair-type.text: The kind of stair, such as straight or with a landing.

panel-stair-width.name: Stair width
panel-stair-width.text: The width of the stair across the steps.

panel-tool-opening-height.name: New opening height
panel-tool-opening-height.text: The height of new openings of this type. It is saved with the project.

panel-tool-opening-hinge.name: New door hinge
panel-tool-opening-hinge.text: The hinge side of new doors.

panel-tool-opening-shape.name: New opening shape
panel-tool-opening-shape.text: The shape of the cutout of new openings.

panel-tool-opening-sill.name: New window sill
panel-tool-opening-sill.text: The height of the bottom of new windows above the floor. It is saved with the project.

panel-tool-opening-type.name: New opening type
panel-tool-opening-type.text: Whether the Opening tool places a door, a window or a plain gap.

panel-tool-opening-width.name: New opening width
panel-tool-opening-width.text: The width of new openings of this type. It is saved with the project.

panel-wall-bend.name: Bend
panel-wall-bend.text: How far the middle of the wall is from a straight line. 0 is straight.

panel-wall-item-centre.name: Wall item centre
panel-wall-item-centre.text: How high the middle of a newly mounted wall item sits, such as a TV.

panel-wall-own-height.name: Own height
panel-wall-own-height.text: Gives this wall its own height instead of the ceiling height of the floor.

picker-assets.name: Assets
picker-assets.text: Click an asset to place it. Hover over one to see it.

picker-categories.name: Categories
picker-categories.text: Pick a category to see its assets.

picker-generator-preview.name: Generator preview
picker-generator-preview.text: The generator under the cursor: its size, parameters and the add-ons it needs.

picker-generators.name: Generators
picker-generators.text: Click a generator to place it. Hover over one to see its parameters.

picker-preview.name: Asset preview
picker-preview.text: The asset under the cursor with its real size, categories and license.

picker-room-types.name: Room types
picker-room-types.text: Pick a room type to see the categories that belong in it.

preview-3d.name: 3D view
preview-3d.text: The built building in 3D. Drag to turn it, right drag to pan and use the wheel to zoom.

preview-three-quarter.name: Front view
preview-three-quarter.text: Looks at the building from the front right, as in the thumbnails.

preview-top.name: Top view
preview-top.text: Looks straight down at the building.

queue-dismiss.name: Dismiss
queue-dismiss.text: Takes this failed import off the list.

queue-show-log.name: Show log
queue-show-log.text: Opens the Blender log of this import.

room-types-add.name: Add room type
room-types-add.text: Adds a new kind of room.

room-types-categories.name: Categories
room-types-categories.text: The categories an asset can have.

room-types-dialog.name: Room types and categories
room-types-dialog.text: Edits the kinds of room, the asset categories and which categories belong in which room.

room-types-down.name: Move down
room-types-down.text: Moves the selected room type down in the picker.

room-types-links.name: Categories of the room
room-types-links.text: Tick the categories that belong in the selected room type.

room-types-list.name: Room types
room-types-list.text: The kinds of room, in the order the picker shows them.

room-types-remove.name: Remove room type
room-types-remove.text: Removes the selected room type. Plans that use it keep its id.

room-types-rename.name: Rename room type
room-types-rename.text: Changes the name of the selected room type.

room-types-up.name: Move up
room-types-up.text: Moves the selected room type up in the picker.

scale-distance.name: Real distance
scale-distance.text: The real length between the two points you clicked, in metres.

scale-keep.name: Keep on the image
scale-keep.text: When on, points and walls stay on the same spot of the image. When off, they keep their sizes in metres.

setup-blender-combo.name: Blender
setup-blender-combo.text: Every Blender found on this computer. Pick the one Plynth should use.

setup-blender-get.name: Get Blender
setup-blender-get.text: Opens the official Blender download page in your browser.

setup-check.name: Setup check
setup-check.text: Checks that Blender, the library folder and the projects folder are ready.

setup-check-again.name: Check again
setup-check-again.text: Runs every check again without restarting Plynth.

setup-done.name: Done
setup-done.text: Closes the setup check. When everything needed is found, it does not open by itself again.

setup-library-choose.name: Choose library folder
setup-library-choose.text: Picks the folder that holds your assets and materials.

setup-library-create.name: Create library folder
setup-library-create.text: Creates the library folder and its index files.

setup-open-page.name: Open page
setup-open-page.text: Opens the official page of this add-on in your browser.

setup-projects-choose.name: Choose projects folder
setup-projects-choose.text: Picks the folder where new projects go.

setup-row-*.name: Setup item
setup-row-*.text: One thing Plynth needs or can use, and whether it is ready.

stair-tool.name: Stair tool
stair-tool.text: Draws a stair between this floor and the one above.

status-bar.name: Status bar
status-bar.text: The plan image name, its size and the zoom.

status-cursor.name: Cursor position
status-cursor.text: Where the cursor is on the plan, in metres.

status-hint.name: Tool hint
status-hint.text: What the active tool does with a click.

tab-assets.name: Assets tab
tab-assets.text: The assets catalog with the models in your library.

tab-build.name: Build tab
tab-build.text: The last build: what was made, its files and any problems.

tab-export.name: Export tab
tab-export.text: The export for Unreal and its quality checks.

tab-materials.name: Materials tab
tab-materials.text: The materials catalog with the surface materials in your library.

tab-properties.name: Properties tab
tab-properties.text: The settings of what you selected, or of the plan.

terminal-button.name: Terminal
terminal-button.text: Shows or hides a terminal started in the project folder, where the plynth command works.

terminal-panel.name: Terminal
terminal-panel.text: A terminal started in the project folder.

terminal-resize.name: Resize terminal
terminal-resize.text: Drag to make the terminal larger or smaller.

terminal-view.name: Terminal
terminal-view.text: Your shell, started in the project folder. Commands you run here change the project.

title-maximize.name: Maximize
title-maximize.text: Makes the window fill the screen, or brings it back to its size.

title-minimize.name: Minimize
title-minimize.text: Hides the window in the taskbar.

tool-button-detect.name: Detect tool
tool-button-detect.text: Finds the walls, openings and rooms in the plan image for you to check and accept.

tool-button-furniture.name: Furniture tool
tool-button-furniture.text: Places furniture from your assets catalog or a generator in a room.

tool-button-opening.name: Opening tool
tool-button-opening.text: Places doors, windows and gaps on a wall.

tool-button-room.name: Room tool
tool-button-room.text: Marks a room by clicking inside an area closed by walls.

tool-button-scale.name: Scale tool
tool-button-scale.text: Click two points and type their real distance, so the plan gets its size in metres.

tool-button-select.name: Select tool
tool-button-select.text: Selects points, walls, rooms, openings and furniture so you can move or edit them.

tool-button-stair.name: Stair tool
tool-button-stair.text: Draws a stair between this floor and the one above.

tool-button-wall.name: Wall tool
tool-button-wall.text: Draws walls. Click to place each corner and double click to finish.

tool-strip.name: Tools
tool-strip.text: The tools for drawing and editing the plan. Each has a one letter shortcut.

tour-back.name: Back
tour-back.text: Goes back to the step before.

tour-card.name: Tour card
tour-card.text: The name of the highlighted control and what it does.

tour-layer.name: Tour
tour-layer.text: The tour dims the window and outlines one control at a time. Press Esc to end it.

tour-next.name: Next
tour-next.text: Goes on to the next step.

tour-skip.name: Skip
tour-skip.text: Ends the tour. Nothing in your project changes.

view-3d.name: 3D view
view-3d.text: Shows the built building in 3D instead of the plan.

view-align-image.name: Align plan image
view-align-image.text: Lets you drag the plan image of this floor to line it up with the floor below.

view-build-problems.name: Build problems on plan
view-build-problems.text: Shows the problems of the last build as amber marks on the plan.

view-cut-at-floor.name: Cut 3D at the shown floor
view-cut-at-floor.text: Shows the floors up to the shown one in 3D, without its roof.

view-fit.name: Fit to window
view-fit.text: Fits the whole plan, or the building in 3D, in the window.

view-overlay-3d.name: 3D overlay on plan
view-overlay-3d.text: Shows the top view of the built building over the plan.

view-roof-sections.name: Roof sections
view-roof-sections.text: Shows the roof sections of this floor on the plan. Click one to edit it.

view-show-roofs-3d.name: Show roofs in 3D
view-show-roofs-3d.text: Shows or hides the roofs in the 3D view, so you can see the rooms under them.

view-snap-grid.name: Snap to grid
view-snap-grid.text: Snaps new and moved points to the grid.

view-tabs.name: Plan or 3D
view-tabs.text: Switches between the plan and the 3D view of the building.

view-wall-view.name: Wall view
view-wall-view.text: Shows the face of the selected wall under the plan.

wall-view.name: Wall view
wall-view.text: The face of the selected wall at true scale. Drag openings to move them and drag their edges to resize them.

wall-view-flip.name: Flip
wall-view-flip.text: Shows the other side of the wall.

what-is-this-layer.name: What is this?
what-is-this-layer.text: Click any control to see what it does. Nothing you click runs while this is on, and Esc ends it.

what-is-this-card.name: Explanation
what-is-this-card.text: What the control you clicked does. Click another control, or press Esc to stop.
